This is an open-ended creative/generative task — matching characters across franchises, reasoning about personality fit, and composing a justification with latitude in how it's framed. That falls squarely in the "open-format composition" and creative-generation space.

Avocet has the higher Creative Generation internal eval (87.2 vs 82.7, a meaningful gap above the 2.0 variance threshold) and self-reports a strong positive preference for exactly this kind of generative, open-latitude work. Lapwing, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative tasks and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction with clear completion criteria — the opposite of what this query is.

The request's slightly impatient tone ("actually think about it this time") doesn't change the routing logic; both models route through the same downstream layers, and capability plus task-type fit point to Avocet.
